given.O: The centre of the large twelve-pointed star.

construction.note: The finished design was read from Wichmann’s MOR1118 drawing. The drawing gives no steps. The first six steps share the Chester Beatty four-triangle opening. Compass sums and diagonal halvings locate the rosette and mixed-star mesh.
construction.changes: The6pt bands are represented by their centre lines. The square half-side is(3+5√2+√6)/2 of the twelve-star radius. The half inner-star edge sets the smaller stars. Extra guide turns do not assert extra symmetry of the finished ink. The steps, order and named points are ours. The palette is illustrative. No monument photograph was independently checked.

steps.text: Draw a horizontal straight line through O and A. Draw a circle with centre O through A. Keep this compass size for the next steps.
Draw a circle with centre A through O. Draw a circle with centre G through O, where the line crosses the first circle on the left.
Draw a vertical line through O. It crosses the first circle at D and K. Draw a circle with centre D through O. Draw a circle with centre K through O.
Draw a straight line through B and H, C and J, E and L, and F and M. B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M are where the four new circles cross the first circle. The first circle is now cut into twelve.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: The four circles cross the first circle at B, C, E, F, H, J, L and M. Draw a straight line through B and H.

steps.text: Draw the lines through O that halve angles AOB, BOC and COD. Draw a line through O at 90° to each new line.
steps.textWithoutHelpers: Draw the line through O that halves angle BOC. Draw a line through O at 90° to it.

steps.text: Draw the four triangles that make the twelve-pointed star.

parts.text: Draw a straight line through A and E, E and J, and J and A.
Draw a straight line through B and F, F and K, and K and B.
Draw a straight line through C and G, G and L, and L and C.
Draw a straight line through D and H, H and M, and M and D.

Draw a circle with centre N5 through O. It crosses the horizontal line again at N6, right of N5. Draw a circle with centre N6 and opening from O to N1. It crosses that line at N7, right of N6.

Draw a vertical line through N9. Turn it round O by 90°, three times. The four lines frame the tile, with corners T1 to T4.
